note: Revisit the five previously requested families using current Shared Rhythm and Open Praise masters. Earlier concept rankings do not apply. HEX values are screen exploration only; no palette is approved.

roles.secondary: Supporting surface or accent only. Pair each usage with a checked contrasting foreground.
roles.accent: Small layout accents; no pale gold body copy on light backgrounds. Symbol stays one solid ink.

palettes.name: Navy & gold
palettes.note: A dignified, dependable foundation. The familiar church and luxury associations place more responsibility on the mark to feel distinctive.
palettes.print: Strong dark-on-light reproduction. Gold is a flat screen color here; foil or metallic ink would be a separate material decision.

palettes.name: Forest & cream
palettes.note: Warm and grounded, with a generous feeling of welcome. It can lean toward heritage, nature, or hospitality rather than a distinctive contemporary church.
palettes.print: A useful everyday one-color foundation. Proof cream papers and dark green inks together; screen warmth is not a paper specification.

palettes.name: Teal & sand
palettes.note: The strongest balance of contemporary distinction and tactile warmth. Sand softens the cool foundation, while gold adds a measured ceremonial note.
palettes.print: Test teal on the intended stock and sign material. Sand works as a supporting surface with dark teal type; it is not a text color on porcelain.

palettes.name: Burgundy & stone
palettes.note: Expressive and ceremonial, with an intimate warmth. It feels more solemn than the other options; potentially useful seasonal territory.
palettes.print: Deep burgundy can gain density in print. Proof it on the real stock; keep small text on the high-contrast primary/neutral pair.

palettes.name: Charcoal & copper
palettes.note: The most neutral and versatile system. Copper supplies warmth; recognition depends heavily on the symbol and wordmark rather than the hue.
palettes.print: A practical signage and monochrome foundation. Copper is a flat accent, not a promise of a metallic finish.

recommendations.status: Provisional editorial starting point, awaiting current visual review.
